what: Antero Resources produces natural gas and natural gas liquids from the Marcellus and Utica shales in Appalachia, and is the largest American exporter of propane and butane by ship.
customers: Gas utilities and power generators, petrochemical plants, and overseas buyers of propane.
money: dry and wet gas from Appalachian wells
propane, butane and ethane, much of it exported
moat: Acreage in the liquids-rich window of Appalachia plus firm transport contracts to the Gulf Coast, which let it sell liquids at export prices rather than depressed local ones.
risks: Gas and propane prices set the revenue entirely
Revenue swung from $7.1B to $4.3B and back to $5.3B in three years
opportunities: 8.1 times earnings and 5 times free cash flow with $2.2B of free cash flow
Analysts see about 39% upside, with 22 covering the stock
Propane exports to Asia and Europe pay far more than the American market, and Antero has the transport to reach them
watch: Realised liquids prices against benchmarks, and free cash flow after capital spending.
